name: Exp_ColorMETRO_DeMarker
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorMETRO_DeMarker custom indicator, which applies a step-filtered DeMarker oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast step line crosses above the slow step line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMETRO_DeMarker自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对DeMarker震荡器施加阶梯过滤。当快速阶梯线上穿慢速阶梯线时开多仓，反之开空仓，配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ColorMETRO_DeMarker指标的双线交叉信号进行动量交易。ColorMETRO_DeMarker指标对DeMarker震荡指标施加快慢两个阶梯过滤（StepSize），生成两条阶梯线MPlus和MMinus。入场条件为：当MPlus[1]>MMinus[1]且MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0]时产生买入开仓信号，表示快速线从下方穿越慢速线向上；当MPlus[1]<MMinus[1]且MPlus[0]>=MMinus[0]时产生卖出开仓信号，表示快速线从上方穿越慢速线向下。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理委托给TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数处理，支持5种不同的资金管理模式。策略在新K线形成时检测信号以避免重复交易，但缺乏点差过滤和加仓保护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on dual-line crossover signals from the ColorMETRO_DeMarker indicator, which applies fast and slow step filters (StepSize) to the DeMarker oscillator, generating two step lines (MPlus and MMinus). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when MPlus[1]>MMinus[1] and MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0], indicating the fast line crossed above the slow line; a sell signal is generated when MPlus[1]<MMinus[1] and MPlus[0]>=MMinus[0], indicating the fast line crossed below the slow line. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals triggering position closure, combined with fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) levels. Position sizing supports multiple modes via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting 5 different money management modes. The strategy detects signals on new bar formation to avoid repeated trading, but lacks spread filtering and position accumulation protection mechanisms.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易手数或资金管理比例
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（按自由保证金/余额/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: MM mode: free margin/balance/loss margin/fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引

pros: 阶梯过滤机制有效减少DeMarker指标的噪音信号，避免频繁交易
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
新K线检测机制避免同根K线内重复交易，减少无效信号
买卖开平仓可独立开关控制，便于策略部分启用或优化
使用自定义指标句柄和CopyBuffer方式获取数据，架构规范
pros_en: The step filter mechanism effectively reduces noise from the DeMarker oscillator, avoiding frequent trading
Supports multiple money management modes with high flexibility for different risk preferences
New bar detection prevents repeated trading within the same bar, reducing invalid signals
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, enabling partial strategy activation or optimization
Uses custom indicator handles and CopyBuffer for data retrieval, following proper MQL5 architecture
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（ATR）动态调整
没有持仓检查机制，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
信号仅在K线闭合时检测，可能错过快速行情中的入场时机
依赖外部自定义指标ColorMETRO_DeMarker，若缺失则EA无法运行且仅打印警告不停止初始化
cons_en: Lacks spread filtering, which may lead to unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed point values without ATR-based dynamic adjustment for volatility
No position check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Signals are only detected on bar close, potentially missing entry opportunities in fast-moving markets
Depends on external custom indicator ColorMETRO_DeMarker; if missing, EA runs with invalid handle and only prints a warning without stopping initialization
improvements: 增加点差过滤条件，当当前点差超过阈值时跳过交易信号
在开仓前检查同向持仓，避免重复建仓导致风险敞口过大
将OnInit中指标句柄创建失败时返回INIT_FAILED而非继续运行
考虑加入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整
improvements_en: Add spread filtering to skip trade signals when current spread exceeds a threshold
Check existing same-direction positions before opening new ones to avoid excessive risk exposure from duplicate entries
Return INIT_FAILED in OnInit when indicator handle creation fails instead of continuing to run
Consider implementing ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit for volatility-adaptive adjustment

risk_points: 指标句柄创建失败时EA不会停止初始化，可能导致后续所有CopyBuffer调用失败并反复触发Recount
没有持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口失控
固定止损1000点和止盈2000点在小周期或高波动品种上可能不合适
默认使用H8周期，但止损止盈点数与周期不匹配时风险较大
risk_points_en: EA does not stop initialization when indicator handle creation fails, potentially causing all CopyBuffer calls to fail and repeatedly trigger Recount
No position count check, potentially opening duplicate same-direction positions leading to uncontrolled risk exposure
Fixed 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit may be inappropriate for small timeframes or high-volatility instruments
Default H8 timeframe combined with mismatched stop/take-profit points creates significant risk
